the COO who runs the teams that would use it
the owner-manager of a 12-person business with no technical staff

points.point: "Before it is given work" was unclear (all four buyers).
points.why: The opening now says: before any other program may hand it a job.

points.point: "Each number has its source one click away" did not say how.
points.why: The heading now says: press "receipt" under a number to open the file it comes from.
The parts list now says drift spots a part that passed before and fails now, and names the promise it broke.
The limits now say what a judge is: a part’s own check of its own answers.

points.point: "Escalated to kar": who is Kar? (all four buyers)
points.why: The operations card now says work a part should not take goes to a named owner, here Kar, the AI that keeps this estate. The support panel already said Kar is an AI with one human owner.

points.point: "No outside organisation has deployed it": deployed what?
"Nothing else to install and no service to run" was unclear.
points.why: It now says: you add one file and one CI step to each repository, and there is no server to run.
It now says: MIT licence, copyright Simon Gant.

points.point: "Checked again every morning" did not say what.
points.why: The footer now says every part is checked again each morning.

points.point: Terms in the folded parts: foldcache-measure.json, act.carries, word-overlap check, declaring repository, the metabolism, sourced floors, pre-registered rules, retire and restore, the wall-time rule.
points.why: These are in the old page, kept word for word one click away, which the rebuild must not change. The plain version of the idea is in view above them.

points.point: "The diagram is referenced but not shown."
points.why: The page draws the diagram when it runs. The walk read the page as text.

points.point: The four traits were not listed.
points.why: The opening names all four: say what it does, check its own answers, be safe to remove, and turn away work it should not do.

points.point: Measurement details: a shared laptop with eight other agents, the warm run against the cold one.
points.why: These are the old page’s measurement notes, kept as recorded. Changing them would change a record.

points.point: The hourly cost and the one-hour default in the cost case.
points.why: The cost case names its source (ONS ASHE 2025) and lets you put in your own numbers. The default is the old page’s, kept.

points.point: The Konomi credit line says nothing about Konomi.
points.why: It is a fixed credit line, written as the estate’s rules require.

points.point: Support and service levels from AI Native Solutions.
points.why: Support is agreed per deployment, in each deployment’s agreement, as the support panel says.
